bridge_source.conclusion: The bridge declares ZERO assembly attributes and is NOT the cause. Only one MNQBridge copy exists (in AddOns/).

root_cause: NinjaTrader compiles every .cs under bin\Custom into ONE assembly (NinjaTrader.Custom.dll). Two assembly-info files were present in that tree — NinjaTrader's canonical AssemblyInfo.cs and a user-made duplicate AssemblyInfo-moneyboxllc.cs — so each assembly-level attribute was declared twice, yielding CS0579. This latent duplicate only surfaced now because this was the first-ever compile of the Custom tree (no prior NinjaTrader.Custom.dll existed).

fix.action: Moved bin\Custom\AssemblyInfo-moneyboxllc.cs out of the compile tree to CustomBackups_quarantine\AssemblyInfo-moneyboxllc.cs.bak (content preserved).
